[[Violet City]] }} '''Number One Donphan''' (Japanese: '''VS ドンファン''' ''VS {{tt|Donfan|Donphan}}''), titled '''Who's the Leader, Donphan?''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 96th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the sixth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Professor Elm]] is in the [[New Bark Town]] General Hospital, upset about his injuries. His assistant says the real problem is that someone broke into his lab. The assistant says that at least the {{pkmn|Egg}} they had wasn't stolen. Suddenly, {{adv|Gold}} calls them with his [[Pokégear]] and says that {{adv|Silver}} may have stolen {{p|Totodile}}, but with [[Exbo|his Cyndaquil]] he will catch {{adv|Silver}}. Professor Elm and his assistant are shocked to realize that {{p|Cyndaquil}} has been taken too. Meanwhile, [[Joey]] returns Gold's Pokémon to [[Mom (Johto)|Gold's mother]], who says that [[Polibo]] is missing. Joey calls Gold and tells him, and Gold sets out to find Polibo. Gold fails to find Polibo, so he decides to stay on Silver's trail. Meanwhile, Silver sees his wanted poster and does a double take. In [[Violet City]], a thief steals [[Earl Dervish]]'s package and escapes on his {{p|Donphan}}. Gold is buying a rice cake, but when the thief passes by his rice cake gets covered in dirt. Enraged, Gold chases after the thief. Earl asks Gold to recover his bag for him. Gold continues chasing the thief and says that all the thief needs to do is buy him a new rice cake. The thief orders Donphan to attack, so Gold retaliates by having [[Aibo]] use {{m|Double Team}}. This causes Donphan to get confused and crash into a wall, defeated. To thank Gold, Earl buys him a huge stack of rice cakes. Earl then tells Gold that Professor Elm's assistant is coming to Violet City. Meanwhile, {{adv|Professor Oak}} and Professor Elm are having a conversation about Gold. Professor Oak says he is worried, because Gold is even more hotheaded than {{adv|Red}}. Back in Violet City, Gold says that he needs to get some results or Professor Elm's assistant will yell at him for taking [[Exbo]]. He asks the thief if he has seen Silver, but the thief hasn't. Luckily for Gold, a nearby girl has seen him. She tells Gold that Silver is at [[Sprout Tower]]. ==Major events== * [[Professor Elm]] finds out that {{adv|Gold}} has taken {{p|Cyndaquil}}. * Gold learns that [[Polibo]] is missing. * Gold stops a thief from stealing [[Earl Dervish]]'s package. * Gold finds out that Silver is at [[Sprout Tower]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Earl Dervish]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Donphan}} * {{p|Chinchou}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Gold}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * [[Professor Elm]] * [[Joey]] * [[Mom (Johto)|Gold's mother]] * [[Earl Dervish]] * Professor Elm's assistant * Thief * Food salesmen ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Aipom}} ([[Aibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Poliwag}} ([[Polibo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Cyndaquil}} ([[Exbo]]; {{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Lickitung}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Weedle}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Drowzee}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Oddish}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Sandshrew}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Krabby}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s) * {{p|Chinchou}} ({{adv|Gold}}'s; new; released) * {{p|Spearow}} ({{adv|Professor Oak}}'s) * {{p|Chikorita}} ([[Megaree|Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Sentret}} ([[Professor Elm]]'s) * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Joey]]'s) * {{p|Donphan}} (Thief's; multiple) * {{p|Togepi}} ({{pkmn|egg}}) * {{p|Electrode}} (drawing) * {{p|Fearow}} ==Trivia== * The [[VIZ Media]] title of this chapter comes from the phrase "#1 fan". ===Errors=== *In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, the [[Sprout Tower]] is called '''Bellsprout's Pagoda'''. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 頓甲|VS Donphan}} (Taiwan)
